text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Posts and Telecommunications Corporation will spend $104 million on the construction of 30 new posts offices throughout the country over the next five years.

- The Zimbabwe Tobacco Association says it is strongly concerned over the proposed Tobacco Marketing and Levy Amendment Bill, and that while it is not opposed to the amendment bill, nationalisation of the growers levy could signal a death knell to the industry.
- A merger between farming implements manufacturer Zimplow and Amalgamated Metal is expected to be finalised soon following an agreement on terms and conditions by both parties.
